pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: uat/driver/verdict.cjs:109 Simulated user journeys are gated through deterministic code checks, unified metric projections, and audited gap waivers, preventing subjective model drift from masking acceptance regressions.

techniques.evidence: uat/driver/verdict.cjs:109 The journey verdict is calculated strictly in code by verdictOf from row answers and metric gates rather than accepting the judge's self-reported verdict; the judge's verdict is tracked separately in judgeVerdict.
uat/driver/verdict.cjs:93 When a metric denominator is zero or counts are missing, the gate evaluates to conditional: nothing counted rather than silently passing or falsely failing.
uat/driver/metrics.cjs:2 The metric registry acts as the single source of truth from which the judge schema, journey gates, before/after delta comparisons, and report sections are projected.
uat/accepted-gaps.md:7 Standing waivers AG-1 through AG-5 explicitly identify the finding class, rationale, and specific ceiling bounds.
uat/driver/ledger.cjs:18 Open findings across runs track unasked occurrences, ensuring unaddressed quality gaps age visibly rather than quietly dropping out of view.
uat/accepted-gaps.md:10 Explicitly partitions what the text-live LT simulation substrate can evaluate from concerns requiring L2 device hardware evaluation.
uat/driver/recertify.cjs:193 Advancement of a finding from open to fixed requires stamping recertify_run, recertify_status, and recertify_evidence.
uat/driver/linga-text.cjs:46 The preflight check refusing the codex engine provides the exact remedy command: unset it and run again.
tools/uat-verdict-test.cjs:9 Verdict tests execute deterministically against committed fixtures without model or network calls.
uat/driver/recertify.cjs:2 Recertification ladders checks by executing only affected character x journey pairs before escalating to broader runs.
uat/driver/recertify.cjs:13 Recertification evaluates against identical code verdict criteria, preventing regression thresholds from drifting during repair.
uat/driver/linga-text.cjs:69 Screens presented to the judge are capped at 8000 characters per step, ensuring the decision evaluation window remains finite and bounded.
uat/driver/verdict.cjs:142 Verdict severity is constructed hierarchically from component reasons, mapping any critical check failure directly to fail.
uat/driver/metrics.cjs:17 Informative metrics like recall are explicitly flagged informative: true and excluded from gating regressions.
tools/uat-metrics-test.cjs:112 Test verifies bidirectional consistency between rubric prose rows in rubric.md and code metrics in metrics.cjs.
uat/driver/surface.cjs:6 The driver inspects server-rendered HTML output from react-dom/server rather than regex-matching raw React source components.
tools/uat-metrics-test.cjs:117 Asserts that invoking invalid journey names fails immediately during argument parsing rather than exiting 0 vacuously.
